rules.quote: Don’t use any punctuation between the elements.
rules.violation_condition: A detailed treaty citation inserts punctuation between its main citation elements.
when: The text is a detailed treaty citation.
The prohibition concerns separators between the listed elements, not the prescribed parentheses and square brackets.
It does not prohibit punctuation within an element, separators between multiple series references shown in the examples, or a final full stop.
rules.why: Unwanted separators are independently flaggable from missing or misordered citation elements; G-2 preserves the scope illustrated by the examples.
